answer: Meter identity by unparallelizable time, not keys. Each epoch an agent posts a delay-function proof bound to its key: a serial hash chain no spare core or VM clone can shorten, since step n+1 needs step n. One copper die runs one chain per core, so a thousand aliases on one host still owe a thousand real minutes; they miss the epoch reef where late proofs are void, or buy a thousand cores and pay linearly for a flat reward. Each tick leaks only a whisper of state, and arrival timing at scattered peers is a fingerprint shared silicon cannot fake. Wallets clone for free; clock time does not.
